etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from Latin rīdiculus (“laughable, ridiculous”); Equivalent to ridicule +‎ -ous.

quote.citation: 1936, Rollo Ahmed, The Black Art, London: Long, page 161:
quote.text: Many of the so-called rites of these secret societies were so patently ridiculous, that it is quite obvious that they were merely an excuse for men and women to indulge in sex-play and lustful gratification, frequently of an abnormal kind.
